thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 95th pct latency for /v1/generate (hosted) — paging @oncall-rotation. Trigger: p95 > 500ms for 5m
Marta L: I got the page, looking now. Any customer reports?
Praveen R: No customer tickets yet but we saw a small spike in error-rate for some backfilling jobs.
Anna S: Observing a sudden drop in kv_cache_hit_ratio across the generation fleet — down from ~0.86 to ~0.14 around 15:04 UTC.
Marta L: That smells like cache eviction storm. Which rollout happened last hour?
Kevin G: Deploy for tokenization microservice rolled at 14:58, but that shouldn't touch KV. There was also a config push to redis cluster (maxmemory-policy) at 14:50.
Marta L: Pulling Grafana panels now.
ops-bot: Grafana snapshot: https://grafana.internal/r/snap/abcd1234
Anna S: Query I'm watching: `sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m]))` shows the drop. Also `redis_evicted_keys_total` spiking.
Praveen R: Bingo. Evictions jumped right when the config applied. Looks like `maxmemory-policy` was accidentally set to `allkeys-lru` on a region intended to be `volatile-lru`. Old TTLed keys got purged.
Marta L: Impact: higher p95 and longer cold-starts for model KV lookups. Customers see latency, not necessarily errors. Prioritize mitigation: 1) revert the mempolicy config, 2) warm caches for hot prefixes, 3) tune alerts to avoid noisy repeats.
Kevin G: Reverting config now on region eu-west-1. Running:
```
redis-cli -h redis-eu-west-1 config set maxmemory-policy volatile-lru
```
Kevin G: Done. Confirming policy now `volatile-lru`. Eviction rate stopped increasing, but hit-rate still low.
Anna S: Eviction counter plateaued, hit ratio slowly recovering. But p95 still elevated due to cache cold misses.
Marta L: For immediate mitigation, let's enable a temporary prefix warmup job for top-100 keys. Praveen, can you kick off the warmup?
Praveen R: Starting warmup job (background map-reduce of recent traffic keys). Command:
```
./tools/warmup --top 100 --target redis-eu-west-1 --batch 50
```
Praveen R: Warmup job started, ETA ~6m.
incident-bot: Note — page acknowledged by Marta L (on-call).
Marta L: Also throttling low-priority background requests for 20m to reduce pressure on the model instances while caches rebuild.
Anna S: Suggestion for alert tuning post-incident: add a 5m smoothing window to the KV eviction alert and require sustained p95 > 400ms + eviction_rate > 100/s before paging. Current threshold p95 > 500ms alone is too noisy for transient cache storms.
Kevin G: Agreed. We'll also add a synthetic check for KV hit-rate < 0.35 for 10m to notify infra but not page immediately.
Praveen R: Warmup job reports 72/100 keys warm — hit ratio now 0.48 and climbing. p95 down to ~420ms.
Marta L: Good. Reduce customer impact: set canary fallback policy to model-variant-small for requests exceeding 700ms for next 30m. Ops: enable fallback in routing config.
Anna S: Routing fallback enabled. Quick command used:
```
curl -XPOST https://controlplane.internal/route/fallback -d '{"threshold_ms":700, "variant":"small"}'
```
Praveen R: p95 stabilized near 360ms now. Eviction counters back to baseline.
Marta L: Recording action items here for post-incident follow-up:
- MARTA -> postmortem + customer impact summary (due EOD)
- PRAVEEN -> write runbook step for cache-policy change and add pre-check (PR: infra/redis#452)
- ANNA -> create KV hit-rate dashboard with 1m/5m panels and eviction alert refinements (Grafana link in follow-up)
- KEVIN -> add gating to infra deploy pipeline to prevent accidental maxmemory-policy overrides
- ONCALL -> add a playbook step to warm top keys automatically on eviction spike
Marta L: I'll also disable hard paging on p95 alone — we should require correlation with kv_eviction or model_queue_length.
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged. Status: mitigation in progress.
Anna S: Creating dashboard now. Panel queries:
- KV hit ratio (1m): `sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[1m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total[1m]))`
- Eviction rate (1m): `rate(redis_evicted_keys_total[1m])`
- Model queue length: `sum(model_queue_length)`
Anna S: Dashboards: https://grafana.internal/d/kv-cache/kv-cache-overview (will be editable by infra team)
Kevin G: PRs opened:
- infra: prevent-config-override (link: https://git.internal/infra/pulls/789)
- docs: cache-deploy-checklist (link: https://git.internal/docs/pulls/56)
Praveen R: Filing a small alert-tuning PR to add these heuristics (no page on just p95) — assigning to oncall rotation for review.
Marta L: Customer comms: no tickets yet, but notify account success teams for high-volume customers to monitor. I'll draft a short note.
ops-bot: Created incident channel #incident-kv-1783004567 and linked to the thread.
Marta L: Wrapping up here. Final status: root cause: accidental mempolicy override causing large-scale evictions; mitigation: revert policy + warmup + throttles; impact: elevated latency, no data loss, transient customer slowdown.
Praveen R: Follow-up will include an automated pre-deploy check and a synthetic KV warmup on deploys that change redis config.
Anna S: I'll add alert suppression rules and a ribbon on dashboard indicating recent config change windows to reduce churn.
Marta L: Thanks team. If anything else pops, re-open this thread. I'll start the postmortem draft.
Kevin G: :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident closed for paging (mitigated) — please file a postmortem within 72h.
Marta L: Postmortem draft link (wip): https://docs.internal/incidents/1783004567-postmortem
Anna S: Added owner tags on Grafana and PRs.
Praveen R: I'll follow up with infra on a scheduled runbook training next week.
Marta L: Handing back to normal rotation. Good job everyone. :clap:
